parameters.name: Affinity
parameters.description: Specifies whether the instance on a dedicated host is associated with the dedicated host. Valid values:

parameters.name: AutoRenew
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. This parameter takes effect only when `InstanceChargeType` is set to `PrePaid`. Valid values:

parameters.name: AutoRenewPeriod
parameters.description: The auto-renewal period. This parameter is required when AutoRenew is set to True.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. **ClientToken** can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the cluster to which the instance belongs.

parameters.name: CreditSpecification
parameters.description: The running mode of the burstable instance. Valid values:

parameters.name: DataDisk
parameters.description: The list of data disks.

sub_parameters.name: Category
sub_parameters.description: The category of data disk N. Valid values:

sub_parameters.name: DeleteWithInstance
sub_parameters.description: Specifies whether to release the data disk when the instance is released.

sub_parameters.name: Description
sub_parameters.description: The description of the data disk. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

sub_parameters.name: Device
sub_parameters.description: The mount point of the data disk.

sub_parameters.name: DiskName
sub_parameters.description: The name of the data disk. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), periods (.), and hyphens (-). The name supports characters categorized as letters in Unicode, including Chinese characters.

sub_parameters.name: EncryptAlgorithm
sub_parameters.description: > This parameter is not publicly available.

sub_parameters.name: Encrypted
sub_parameters.description: Specifies whether to encrypt data disk N.

sub_parameters.name: KMSKeyId
sub_parameters.description: The ID of the Key Management Service (KMS) key used by the disk.

sub_parameters.name: PerformanceLevel
sub_parameters.description: The performance level of the enterprise SSD used as a data disk. Settings depend on the disk category. The value of N must be the same as that in `DataDisk.N.Category=cloud_essd`. Valid values:

sub_parameters.name: Size
sub_parameters.description: The size of data disk N, in GiB. Valid values of N: 1 to 16. Valid values:

sub_parameters.name: SnapshotId
sub_parameters.description: The ID of the snapshot used to create data disk N. Valid values of N: 1 to 16.

sub_parameters.name: StorageClusterId
sub_parameters.description: The ID of the dedicated block storage cluster. If you want to use disks in a dedicated block storage cluster as data disks when you create the ECS instance, set this parameter.

parameters.name: DedicatedHostId
parameters.description: The ID of the dedicated host.

parameters.name: DeletionProtection
parameters.description: The release protection attribute of the instance. Specifies whether the instance can be released from the console or by calling the [DeleteInstance](~~25507~~) operation.

parameters.name: DeploymentSetGroupNo
parameters.description: The number of the deployment set group to which to deploy the instance in the deployment set. This parameter takes effect only when the deployment set uses the high availability group strategy (AvailabilityGroup). Valid values: 1 to 7.

parameters.name: DeploymentSetId
parameters.description: The ID of the deployment set.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the instance. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: DryRun
parameters.description: Specifies whether to perform only a dry run. Valid values:

parameters.name: HibernationOptions.Configured
parameters.description: > This parameter is in invitational preview and is not publicly available.

parameters.name: HostName
parameters.description: The hostname of the Elastic Compute Service server.

parameters.name: HpcClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the HPC cluster to which the instance belongs.

parameters.name: HttpEndpoint
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable the access channel for instance metadata. Valid values:

parameters.name: HttpPutResponseHopLimit
parameters.description: > This parameter is not publicly available.

parameters.name: HttpTokens
parameters.description: Specifies whether to forcefully use the security-hardened mode (IMDSv2) to access instance metadata. Valid values:

parameters.name: ImageFamily
parameters.description: The name of the image family. You can set this parameter to obtain the latest available image from the specified image family to create the instance.

parameters.name: ImageId
parameters.description: The ID of the image used to start the instance. To use an Alibaba Cloud Marketplace image, you can view the `ImageId` on the product page of the Alibaba Cloud Marketplace image. This parameter is required if you do not specify `ImageFamily` to select the latest available image from an image family.

parameters.name: InnerIpAddress
parameters.description: The internal IP address of the instance.

parameters.name: InstanceChargeType
parameters.description: The billing method of the instance. Valid values:

parameters.name: InstanceName
parameters.description: The name of the instance. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), periods (.), and hyphens (-). The name supports characters categorized as letters in Unicode, including Chinese characters. If this parameter is not specified, the default value is the instance ID.

parameters.name: InstanceType
parameters.description: The instance type of the instance.

parameters.name: InternetChargeType
parameters.description: The billing method for network usage. Valid values:

parameters.name: InternetMaxBandwidthIn
parameters.description: The maximum inbound public bandwidth, in Mbit/s. Valid values:

parameters.name: InternetMaxBandwidthOut
parameters.description: The maximum outbound public bandwidth, in Mbit/s. Valid values: 0 to 100.

parameters.name: IoOptimized
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the instance is I/O optimization enabled. Valid values:
The default value for [retired instance types](~~55263~~) is none. For other instance types, the default value is optimized.

parameters.name: KeyPairName
parameters.description: The name of the key pair.

parameters.name: NodeControllerId
parameters.description: > This parameter is in invitational preview and is not publicly available.

parameters.name: Password
parameters.description: The password of the instance. The password must be 8 to 30 characters in length and must contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters. The following special characters are supported:

parameters.name: PasswordInherit
parameters.description: Specifies whether to use the password preset in the image. When you use this parameter, the Password parameter must be empty, and you must make sure that the image has a password configured.

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description: The subscription period of the instance. The unit is specified by `PeriodUnit`. This parameter takes effect and is required only when `InstanceChargeType` is set to `PrePaid`. If `DedicatedHostId` is specified, the value of this parameter cannot exceed the subscription period of the dedicated host. Valid values:

parameters.name: PeriodUnit
parameters.description: The unit of the subscription period. Valid values:

parameters.name: PrivateIpAddress
parameters.description: The private IP address of the instance. The IP address must be an available address in the CIDR block of the specified vSwitch (VSwitchId).

parameters.name: PrivatePoolOptions.Id
parameters.description: The ID of the private pool. The ID of the private pool is the same as that of the elasticity assurance or capacity reservation.

parameters.name: PrivatePoolOptions.MatchCriteria
parameters.description: The private pool options for the instance launch. A private pool is generated when an elasticity assurance or a capacity reservation takes effect. You can select a private pool when you start an instance. Valid values:

parameters.name: RamRoleName
parameters.description: The name of the instance RAM role. You can call the RAM API [ListRoles](~~28713~~) to query the instance RAM roles that you have created.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent list of regions.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the enterprise resource group to which the instance belongs.

parameters.name: SecurityEnhancementStrategy
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable security hardening. Valid values:

parameters.name: SecurityGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the security group to which the new instance belongs.

parameters.name: SpotDuration
parameters.description: The protection period of the spot instance, in hours. Default value: 1. Valid values:

parameters.name: SpotInterruptionBehavior
parameters.description: The break mode of the spot instance. Valid values:

parameters.name: SpotPriceLimit
parameters.description: The maximum hourly price of the instance. A maximum of three decimal places are supported. This parameter takes effect only when `SpotStrategy` is set to `SpotWithPriceLimit`.

parameters.name: SpotStrategy
parameters.description: The bidding policy for the instance. This parameter takes effect only when `InstanceChargeType` is set to `PostPaid`. Valid values:

parameters.name: StorageSetId
parameters.description: The ID of the storage set.

parameters.name: StorageSetPartitionNumber
parameters.description: The maximum number of partitions in the storage set. Valid values: greater than or equal to 2.

parameters.name: SystemDisk
parameters.description: The system disk parameters. The dedicated block storage cluster ID (`StorageClusterId`) must be specified by using this parameter.

parameters.name: SystemDisk.Category
parameters.description: The category of the system disk. Valid values:

parameters.name: SystemDisk.Description
parameters.description: The description of the system disk. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: SystemDisk.DiskName
parameters.description: The name of the system disk. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), periods (.), and hyphens (-). The name supports characters categorized as letters in Unicode, including Chinese characters.

parameters.name: SystemDisk.PerformanceLevel
parameters.description: The performance level of the enterprise SSD used as the system disk. Settings depend on the disk category. Valid values:

parameters.name: SystemDisk.Size
parameters.description: The size of the system disk, in GiB. Valid values:

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The tag key of the instance, disk, and primary ENI. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value of the instance, disk, and primary ENI. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: Tenancy
parameters.description: Specifies whether to create the instance on a dedicated host. Valid values:

parameters.name: UseAdditionalService
parameters.description: Specifies whether to use the virtual machine system configuration provided by Alibaba Cloud (Windows: NTP and KMS. Linux: NTP and YUM).

parameters.name: UserData
parameters.description: Instance user data of the instance. Instance user data must be encoded in Base64. The raw data can be up to 32 KB in size.

parameters.name: VSwitchId
parameters.description: The vSwitch ID. This parameter is required if you create a VPC-connected instance. You can call [DescribeVSwitches](~~35748~~) to query created vSwitches.

parameters.name: VlanId
parameters.description: The virtual local area network ID.

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description: The zone ID of the instance. For more information, call [DescribeZones](~~25610~~) to query the zone list.
